name: slack_thread
description: What a Slack thread can state: actions taken, promises, decisions, blockers and questions, about the deals and people it concerns. Status is never extracted.

deal.description: A sales opportunity, by its CRM id.

action_taken.description: something someone says they did (sent the deck, booked the demo), with whom

question_asked.description: an open question someone asks about the deal

price_quoted.description: a price stated in the thread

rep.description: One of our people, by email.

commitment.description: Something someone promised in the thread. An item: commitment:<episode>#<n>.

owner.description: who promised it, by id: rep:<email> for one of ours (the thread's people are listed by id), contact:<email> for someone at the customer; a name only for someone with no id here
